title: Classes: how to choose
summary: 15 classes: the unawakened Human, 6 classes you can pick freely and 8 special classes to earn.

blocks.text: Your class decides your bonuses, your weapons, your armor, your skill tree and your playstyle. Everybody starts as a Human (no class). You can change class from the status window: the first change of a profile is free, later ones cost shards.
blocks.html: Your class decides your bonuses, your weapons, your armor, your skill tree and your playstyle. Everybody starts as a Human (no class). You can change class from the status window: the first change of a profile is free, later ones cost shards.

blocks.text: Normal classes can be picked freely and stop at level 100. Special classes are hidden: their unlock condition is a secret feat, and they go up to level 999. Each class has a role (damage, tank, support or hybrid) and a difficulty (easy, normal, hard).
blocks.html:
